content.text: Imagine you're a digital creator in Zimbabwe, where Stripe and PayPal are blocked due to international sanctions. Your crypto store could be thriving, but you're stuck with a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-step-step-deployment-2|Payment Solutions]]-methods-filipino-digital-creators-how-one-creator|payment]] processor that's unreliable and expensive. This is the exact problem that COREMERCH solves with its infrastructure stacks, empowering creators to build and manage their own crypto stores without relying on foreign platforms.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

When platforms like Stripe and PayPal fail, COREMERCH's infrastructure stacks kick in, providing a reliable and scalable solution for digital creators. With a focus on sovereignty, COREMERCH's stacks are designed to be self-sufficient, allowing creators to manage their own crypto stores without relying on external payment processors. This means that creators can avoid expensive transaction fees, data ownership issues, and the risk of platform shutdowns.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can deploy COREMERCH's infrastructure stacks, you'll need to have a solid [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/understanding-usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-plain-language|COREMERCH guide to understanding]] of the technical requirements. This includes setting up a Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages site, configuring a payment processor like NOWPayments, and connecting it to a storage solution like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Additionally, you'll need to have a digital product ready to sell, such as an ebook or software.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

The NOWPayments configuration sequence is the same regardless of which stack you are deploying. Create a NOWPayments account — no KYC required, no document upload, no bank account needed. Navigate to the wallet settings and add the wallet addresses for each cryptocurrency you want to accept. USDT on Tron and Bitcoin are the practical starting point for most creators in restricted markets. Generate an API key from the NOWPayments dashboard. Set the webhook endpoint URL in the NOWPayments IPN settings pointing to your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App. Set the webhook secret key — a string you generate that both NOWPayments and your backend know.
COREMERCH's infrastructure stacks are designed to be self-sufficient, allowing creators to manage their own crypto stores without relying on external payment processors.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Testing before promotion is not optional — it is the step that determines whether your store functions correctly under real conditions before real buyers encounter it. The test sequence has four steps. First: deploy the backend and confirm the webhook endpoint returns a valid response to a test HTTP POST. Second: configure the storefront and confirm the checkout displays correctly on desktop and mobile. Third: complete a real mainnet transaction with a small amount of actual crypto. Fourth: check your order database and confirm the order was logged correctly, the delivery email arrived, and the download link works.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

The post-deployment ownership transfer is explicit in every COREMERCH deployment. When the build is complete and the end-to-end test passes, COREMERCH provides the credentials and configuration details for every component under the customer's accounts. The GitHub or Cloudflare repository is under the customer's account from the start. The Supabase or Google Sheets database is under the customer's account. The NOWPayments account is under the customer's email. COREMERCH removes collaborator access upon delivery. From that point, the store runs entirely under the customer's own accounts.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The most important question you may have is, 'Can I really build a crypto store that accepts payments for free?' The answer is yes, with COREMERCH's infrastructure stacks. By leveraging free hosting solutions like Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages, you can build a crypto store that accepts payments without incurring any transaction fees. This means that you can keep more of your revenue and focus on growing your business.

You can also explore COREMERCH's Shop URL at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy COREMERCH's infrastructure stacks, follow these concrete steps: Set up a Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages site in 4-6 hours using the Sovereign Blueprint. Configure NOWPayments to work with your site. Connect a payment processor like NOWPayments to a storage solution like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Test your payment and delivery pipeline on the mainnet. Process your first transaction and start promoting your crypto store to customers. Scale your store by adding more products, increasing your pricing, and marketing your store to a wider audience.
